asks: Keep Lesser Slave Lake as it is, not split four ways, with its southern boundary moved to take in all of Big Lakes County and Swan Hills.

quote: I would recommend strongly that the future recommendation be that boundaries remain as they are currently, with the exception that the southern boundary be moved south to include all of Big Lakes county
note: Former Big Lakes County reeve. Rejection: 'going back to having four MLAs representing one municipality, I just don’t see that as a workable situation at all.' Quote precedes the record's first EB label (EB-592), so page range given. Adding Swan Hills matches both final maps' LSL additions.

asks: Do not divide the Lesser Slave Lake region and its Indigenous communities; if population is short, add neighbouring areas rather than split it.

quote: If the population is the driver but this particular region is unique for other reasons, maybe that can be addressed in a different way than dividing.
note: Presented with Jennifer (Lesser Slave Lake regional council). Also: 'a real concern in the Indigenous community that if the constituency is split as proposed' (before EB-595). Record opens mid-presentation (the first part, by Jennifer, is not in it).

asks: Use all four section 15(2) exceptions for northern ridings and keep rural seats rather than equalize population; no place among the eleven elements is named.
Keep seven electoral divisions in northwestern Alberta and keep the Grande Prairie and Grande Prairie-Wapiti boundaries as they are.
Do not create the interim Calgary-Confluence riding; put Calgary's added seat in the growing south (or northwest), possibly using hybrid ridings there.
Add Blackfalds to the riding's name and keep Blackfalds in a north-south Highway 2 riding with Lacombe, Innisfail or Sylvan Lake rather than an east-west riding reaching Rocky Mountain House.

quote: Adding more municipalities to the boundary, Bentley and Rocky Mountain House, may make it difficult to get the attention required for local issues
note: Blackfalds mayor. Objects to Blackfalds sharing the interim Lacombe-Rocky Mountain House riding and wants a north-south Highway 2 riding, but says nothing about Clearwater County or how the west-central riding should be drawn; mention only (rule 17). Also welcomes sharing an MLA with Lacombe.
Red Deer named only as where Blackfalds residents work and shop (answers to commissioners); no request about joining the city with Blackfalds.

asks: Make Lethbridge's ridings urban-rural hybrids (three or four), and if two city ridings are kept, run the dividing line straight up 13th Street and Scenic Drive.

quote: I would say that hybrid ridings represent solutions to all the most vexing issues for effective representation across Alberta, and I would urge you to enact them in the new representation map for Lethbridge.
note: Asks for 'three or four hybrid ridings in Lethbridge', so direction, not exact. Fallback: if two city ridings stay (L1), redraw the line along 13th Street and Scenic Drive. Quote precedes the record's first EB label (EB-607). Also open to a minimalist hybrid with Coalhurst and Coaldale when asked.

asks: Give Medicine Hat its own riding with the surrounding counties in a rural riding, or failing that make the river the dividing line, and move Veinerville into Cypress-Medicine Hat.
Keep Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre as it is and Clearwater County whole, along Highways 11 and 22, and do not join Rocky Mountain House to Lacombe across Highway 2.

quote: please use the full range of population possibilities from 41,198 to consider the status quo with respect to the boundaries in Rimbey-Rocky Mountain House-Sundre. Keep Clearwater county together.
note: Quote precedes the record's first EB label (EB-611). Rejection of joining Rocky to Lacombe: 'Connecting Rocky Mountain House to communities on the other side of highway 2 appears to be an attempt to create a community of interest where currently there is none' and (EB-611) 'do not create electoral divisions that cross highway 2'. W2 rejected because he argues against Rocky with Lacombe itself (medium on W2). Fallback: Sylvan Lake or Drayton Valley as a 'better hybrid choice' than Lacombe.

asks: Redraw the central Alberta riding as Blackfalds-Delburne-Innisfail along Highways 2, 2A and 21, moving Sylvan Lake to Lacombe, and not join part of Red Deer city with Penhold.

quote: If you were to expand it towards Penhold to create hypothetically such a hybrid riding, it would create the dilemma of needing to splinter up all of central Alberta as a cascade.
note: Answer to Mr. Clark's question about a hybrid of part of Red Deer city with Penhold; argues the city's limits mark its population and that a hybrid would diminish the outlying towns' representation. No positive want for the city stated. Trochu named in his proposed Innisfail riding (not an Olds request about the city).

quote: I think Sylvan Lake would be most appropriate being grouped into Lacombe, as it actually handily remedies some of the discussion points that Mr. Duiker raised with concern to representation for the Rocky Mountain House region.
note: Refers to the Rocky Mountain House region only through Sylvan Lake going to Lacombe and 'Eckville, Caroline, Lacombe, and Sylvan Lake' as an option for the riding north; no stance on Clearwater County. Mention only.

quote: Penhold, Innisfail, Delburne, Elnora, Pine Lake area, the community of Trochu and Blackfalds: we all have these commuter patterns and work patterns that flow in and out of the city of Red Deer.
note: His proposed Highway 21 riding (Blackfalds-Delburne-Innisfail) includes Trochu, which every map places in the Olds/Mountain View-Kneehill riding; so O9 (Trochu moved out of the prairie riding). The rest of the prairie riding is not discussed. Quote precedes the record's first EB label (EB-613).

asks: Keep the name Innisfail-Sylvan Lake rather than renaming it Sylvan Lake-Innisfail, because of the cost to constituency associations.
Keep Bowden in the same riding as Innisfail, Penhold and central Alberta; she agrees, when asked, with the interim Sylvan Lake-Innisfail riding.

note: Red Deer named only as where Bowden residents work and see specialists; no request about the city's districts.
Olds named only in answer to Mr. Evans about retail travel south on Highway 2; no request about the Olds riding.

asks: Keep the Highway 21 communities (Trochu, Huxley, Elnora, Lousana, Delburne) in one riding by adding Trochu to the interim Sylvan Lake-Innisfail riding, and possibly Blackfalds.

quote: The Chair: As I understand it, you want us to bring Trochu into this Sylvan Lake-Innisfail riding. Is that right? Ms Nelson: Yes.
note: Answer of 'Yes' to the Chair's restatement; her own words: 'My proposal was to have Trochu as an addition'. Trochu sits in the Olds/Mountain View-Kneehill riding on every map, so moving it to Innisfail is O9. Nothing else about the prairie riding.
Codebook: a letter putting Trochu with Innisfail is a REDDEER mention with no want. Only Red Deer County is named, not the city.

asks: Give Medicine Hat one urban riding and one hybrid with south Medicine Hat, all of Cypress County and Forty Mile, and put Brooks and Newell on a north-south axis with Taber and Warner instead; he adds that Airdrie deserves one urban and one hybrid seat.

quote: the Airdrie situation is that it has some similarities to Medicine Hat. It probably deserves one urban seat and one hybrid seat.
note: Former Speaker from Medicine Hat. Wants one Airdrie-only district holding most of the city and one hybrid holding the rest: no listed option (A1 is two hybrids, A3 two city-only districts); the hybrid's partner is not named (rural or Calgary unstated). Quote precedes the record's first EB label (EB-623).
'Lethbridge and Red Deer have two' urban seats, a comparison only (rule 6).
'Lethbridge and Red Deer have two' urban seats, a comparison only (rule 6).

asks: Keep two Lethbridge ridings, make the Oldman River the west boundary of Lethbridge-East north of Highway 3, add the Sunset Acres and Mountain Meadows acreage area of Lethbridge County to Lethbridge-West, and keep Coalhurst out of a Lethbridge riding.

quote: I’m not opposed at all to what the commission has recommended in the preliminary report. All I’m saying is that after speaking with people and taking a better look at what this could look like, I just want to suggest some changes to east and west
note: MLA for Lethbridge-West. Rejection (pp. 191-193, before EB-624): 'wholly urban constituencies are certainly more representative of the people who live in them than blended urban and rural'; also agrees Coalhurst should not be in a Lethbridge riding. Adding a small piece of Lethbridge County west of the city to Lethbridge-West matches the majority's adjustment under L1.

asks: Create one west-central eastern-slopes riding with all of Clearwater County, Rocky Mountain House, O'Chiese and Sunchild, western Mountain View County along Highway 22, Sundre, Caroline and the MD of Bighorn, not divided three ways.

quote: Redraw the boundaries to create a single riding encompassing the entirety of Clearwater county, including Rocky Mountain House, O’Chiese First Nation, Sunchild First Nation, western Mountain View county along highway 22.
note: Former Clearwater County councillor. Rejection (pp. 193-195, before EB-626): 'The proposed constituency of Mountain View-Kneehill will not work. It divides Clearwater into three separate constituencies.' Sundre included.

quote: There’s a fair population west of the river. The way it’s currently drawn, they’d be going into the Banff-Jasper area, which is not fair to those residents at all.
note: Rejects western Clearwater County going to Banff-Jasper. He also asks that the riding take in the MD of Bighorn, but the sentence is garbled in the transcript: 'the MD of Bighorn, excluding the town of Canmore and Banff national park, should include the Banff townsite.' Whether he wants park land or the Banff townsite (B1 or B9) cannot be settled from the text, so no want (rule 17); check against the PDF/audio.

quote: Olds-Didsbury-Three Hills do not have anything in common at all, whether it’s farming practices, the type of farming, whether it’s cattle, grain farming.
note: Wants Sundre and western Mountain View County along Highway 22 in the foothills riding (codebook: 'Sundre belongs with Rocky Mountain House' is O1 here). Rejects the interim Mountain View-Kneehill ('will not work'; 'what does a Rocky resident have in common with someone living in Three Hills'). Says nothing about Crossfield, Irricana or Beiseker, hence direction.

asks: Adopt version 2 of the Okotoks riding, putting Okotoks with Diamond Valley rather than with Calgary-South.
